newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Gintian H1 net dives 54 percent.
newsitem.headline: China's Gintian H1 net dives 54 percent.

text.p: Half year ended June 30, 1997 (in millions of yuan unless stated, against first-half 1996 figures):
Earnings per share 0.0415 yuan vs 0.1074 yuan
Net assets per share 3.41 yuan vs 4.30 yuan
Company name: Gintian Industry (Group) Co Ltd.
NOTE: The results, calculated under Chinese accounting standards, were published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Friday.
Based on international standards, the company posted net profits of 5.06 million yuan for January-June 1997. It did not give a comparative figure.
Trading in Gintian's A and B shares would be suspended on Friday morning pending the announcement, and would resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said.
